title: Schedule of Move-Out Notice, Early Termination and Deposit Return Periods — Home-Site Lease
content:
**Schedule to the Home-Site Lease: notice to vacate, early termination and return of the deposit**

1. *Notice to vacate.* The minimum number of calendar days between the date the community receives a written notice to vacate and the stated vacate date.
2. *Early-termination fee.* The fee for vacating before the end of a fixed term, as a multiple of the contracted monthly site rent.
3. *Waivers of the early-termination fee.* Whether the fee is waived when the lease ends because the home is sold in place to an approved buyer, and whether it is waived for a resident vacating under qualifying military orders.
4. *Return of the deposit.* The calendar days after the lease closes within which the full deposit is refunded when no deduction is taken, and within which the itemized deposit claim is issued and any remainder refunded when a deduction is taken.

| Lot class | Notice to vacate (days) | Early-termination fee (months of rent) | Waived on approved in-place home sale | Waived under military orders | Full refund, no deduction (days after closing) | Itemized claim and remainder (days after closing) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Single-Section Home Site | 30 | 1.0 | yes | yes | 15 | 30 |
| Preferred Single-Section Home Site | 30 | 1.0 | yes | yes | 15 | 30 |
| Standard Multi-Section Home Site | 30 | 1.0 | yes | yes | 15 | 30 |
| Preferred Multi-Section Home Site | 30 | 1.0 | yes | yes | 15 | 30 |
| Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site | 60 | 1.5 | yes | yes | 15 | 30 |
| Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site | 60 | 2.0 | yes | yes | 15 | 30 |

*Hypothetical figures.* On a contracted monthly site rent of 760.00, one month of rent is 760.00, one and a half months is 1,140.00 and two months is 1,520.00.
